newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Chirac wants EU to weigh Albania initiative.
newsitem.headline: Chirac wants EU to weigh Albania initiative.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac is deeply concerned about the situation in Albania and wants the European Union to contribute to any operation to enforce a political settlement there, his spokeswoman said on Friday.

Catherine Colonna said Chirac, in Uruguay on a Latin American tour, was following the situation in Albania closely. He wanted the EU to study possible initiatives and present proposals to end the crisis in the Balkan state, she added.
"France thinks the Europeans must take responsibility. It asks the European Union to study possible initiatives and present proposals," Colonna told reporters.

She said Chirac had asked to be briefed regularly on developments and believed that "together with their partners, the Europeans should be able to contribute to any operation decided in the framework of a political settlement, which is the only way to solve the crisis."
France safely evacuated about 100 people, half of them French, aboard four military helicopters from Albania to Italy on Friday, the foreign ministry said.

Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, who began Chirac's Latin American tour with the president, was returning to attend an informal EU foreign ministers' meeting this weekend in the Netherlands expected to deal mostly with Albania, officials said.
